en-US.name: Patent Disclosure Skills
en-US.summary: Optional local MIT package of Chinese patent skills for disclosure, search, reading, mapping and office-action assistance. Not legal advice; filing still needs a qualified professional. Includes upstream LICENSE in the installed tree and in each child. Optional Python tools and a vendored mermaid.min.js over 1 MiB are included.
en-US.description: Market-local packaging of handsomestWei/patent-disclosure-skill@491524bd36a3f9f8d2e35caa5b56368b67d88ced. The installer copies only the skill content directory, so LICENSE is placed here. Example renderings under docs/ are excluded. This is not legal advice. Package version 2026.11.24.

zh-CN.description: 基于 handsomestWei/patent-disclosure-skill@491524bd36a3f9f8d2e35caa5b56368b67d88ced 的市场本地包装。安装器只复制技能内容目录，因此把 LICENSE 放进本包。docs/ 下的效果例图已排除。本包不是法律意见。包版本 2026.11.24。
